sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Flip Goal are simple yet engaging. The objective of the game is to kick the ball into the goal without hitting other players. The controls are intuitive, allowing you to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play the game. The game's physics engine ensures that the ball behaves realistically, taking into account factors like speed, direction, and spin. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new teams, stadiums, and soccer balls, each with its unique characteristics.

The game's timing-based mechanic is where the real challenge lies. You'll need to time your kick perfectly to score goals, taking into account the speed and direction of the ball. The game's difficulty increases as you progress, but the satisfaction of scoring a goal is unmatched.
